translation.name: Biblica® Ochiw Thuolo Motingʼo Loko Manyien™

content.text: Abiro chungʼ kara mar rito
kendo abiro bedo ewi kuonde moger motingʼore mag rito.
Abiro ngʼicho mondo ane gima obiro wachona,
kendo kuom dwoko mabiro chiwo kuom ywagni.
“Ndik fwenyni
kendo iler tiende maber kama indike,
mondo jaland wach oring katere.
Nikech fwenyni rito kinde moketi;
owuoyo kuom ndalo giko,
kendo ok nobed miriambo.
Kata obedo ni onyalo deko kapok ochopo, rite arita,
adier obiro chopo ma ok odeko.
“Ne kaka osungore;
dwarone ok nikare.
To ngʼat makare nobed mangima kuom yie mare,
chutho, divai momadho ndhoge;
en jasunga kendo osiko otimo gik maricho ma ok ool.
Nikech owuor ka liel mamuonyo ji
kendo kaka tho ok rom e kaka en bende ok orom,
ochoko ogendini duto mondo obi ire,
kendo omako ji duto wasumbini.

content: “To donge jogi biro kwede ka ngʼongʼone kendo jare kawacho niya,

content.text: “ ‘Inine malit in ngʼama choko gik mokwal
kendo mabedo ja-mwandu gi gige mecho.
Nyaka karangʼo ma gigi nodhi nyime katimore?’
To donge jogopeu biro poyou?
Donge gibiro chiewo ma gimi utetni?
Eka unubed wasumbinigi.
Nikech useyako ogendini mangʼeny,
joma odongʼ biro mayou.
Nimar usechwero remb dhano,
useketho pinje, mier madongo kod ji duto manie igi.
“Ngʼat mayudo mwandu gi yore ma ok owinjore none malit
kendo ogero ode kama otingʼore gi malo,
mondo otony ne kethruok!
Isechano kethruok mar ogendini mangʼeny,
ma osemiyo odi owuon wichkuot kendo iwito ngimani.
Kite mag kor ot noywagnu matek
to yiend tado nokow ywagno.
“Ngʼat magero dalane gi remo
kendo guro dala maduongʼ gi gige mecho enone malit!
Donge Jehova Nyasaye Maratego osechiko
ni tije ogendini maricho biro bedo ramok mach,
ogendini tiyo ma ol kayiem nono?
Nimar piny biro pongʼ gi ngʼeyo mar duongʼ Jehova Nyasaye
kaka pi kwako nam.
“Enone malit ngʼat mamiyo jobathe math,
ka omedogi ameda nyaka gimer,
mondo one dug-gi.
Wichkuot nomaki kar bedo gi pak.
Koro en kindeni mar mer! Methi kendo dongʼ duk!
Okombe moa e lwet Jehova Nyasaye ma korachwich bironi,
kendo wichkuot biro umo duongʼ ma in-go.
Timbe mahundu ma isetimone Lebanon nonyori
kendo le mane inego marach biro miyi bwok.
Nimar isechwero remb dhano,
iseketho pinje gi mier madongo,
kendo gi ji duto manie igi.
“En ohala manade miyudo kuom nyiseche manono
nimar dhano ema opayogi?
Kata kido mapuonjo miriambo?
Ngʼat malose oketo genone,
kuom gima oloso owuon;
oloso nyiseche manono ma ok nyal wuoyo.
Enone malit ngʼat mawachone yien ni, ‘Bed mangima!’
Kata ni kite maonge ngima ni, ‘Chiew!’
Bende gik ma kamago dingʼadnu rieko?
Kata obedo ni obawgi gi dhahabu gi fedha;
to gionge gi ngima nikech gin gik motho.”
To Jehova Nyasaye nitie e hekalune maler;
piny duto mondo olingʼ e nyime.
